in_sanskrit.name: दर्शन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: to see, to observe, to perceive, to experience, to have a look, to have a glimpse, to have a Darshan of God, to attend a Puja

in_hindi.name: दर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: देखना (to see), दर्शान (one who shows), दर्शन (sight), दर्शना (vision), दर्शनीय (worthy of seeing), दर्शन का आगाज (result of seeing), दर्शन माँगना (to long for a sight), दर्शन के साथ (in the presence of)

in_tamil.name: தர்ஷனம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிறகு (near, close), காண்பதை (to see, to observe), தர்ஷனம் (sight), தர்ஷனப்படும் (becoming visible), தர்ஷனாய் (one who shows), தர்ஷனியம் (worthiness of being seen)

in_telugu.name: దర్శన
in_telugu.long_meaning: దీజనేదు (to see), దర్శణి (sight), దర్శనపోయే (one who shows), దర్శణీయ (worthy of seeing), దర్శణీయే (one who has a vision)

in_marathi.name: Darsan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darsan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। To see, to perceive, to behold, to observe, to witness, to have a vision

in_bengali.name: Darsan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sight, Vision
in_bengali.long_meaning: Darsan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। To see, to perceive, to behold, to observe, to witness, to have a vision
